Settings.title: Settings
Settings.forbidden: You don't have permission to view settings.
Settings.providersHelp: Which gateway sends SMS and collects mobile-money payments for this SACCO. Leave on the default until real provider credentials are ready - the default sends nothing external, but the rest of the app behaves exactly as it will once a real one is active.
Settings.memberNumberingHelp: Set how new member numbers are generated for your SACCO. Existing member numbers are never changed.
Settings.allowedIdTypesHelp: Which ID types staff can select when registering a member. Leave all unchecked to accept any.
